entries.text: 洛托洛托洛托……
entries.label: team_0070_system_01

entries.text: 看來[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳從皮拿那裡拿到\n老大之證團隊徽章了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_02a

entries.text: 看來[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳從秋明那裡拿到\n老大之證團隊徽章了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_02b

entries.text: 看來[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳從奧爾迪加那裡拿到\n老大之證團隊徽章了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_02c

entries.text: 看來[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳從梅洛可那裡拿到\n老大之證團隊徽章了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_02d

entries.text: 看來[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳從枇琶那裡拿到\n老大之證團隊徽章了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_02e

entries.text: 這麼一來，失去老大的\n閣道二小隊就會瀕臨瓦解了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_04a

entries.text: 這麼一來，相信失去老大的\n策星小隊將會走向毀滅。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_04b

entries.text: 這麼一來，失去老大的\n閣道三小隊就要結束了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_04c

entries.text: 這麼一來，失去老大的\n王良四小隊應該就會消失了……[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_04d

entries.text: 這麼一來，失去老大的\n王良一小隊距離解散不遠了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_04e

entries.text: ……抱歉。\n很多事情湧上了我的心頭。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_06

entries.text: 現在剩下２座基地……\n星塵大作戰進行得很順利呢。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_07

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n我想告訴[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳這個作戰的最終目的。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_08

entries.text: 那就是……打倒號召了５名老大，\n創建天星隊的……\r\n真正幕後黑手[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]真老大[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_09

entries.text: 那是什麼樣的人？
entries.label: team_0070_select_01

entries.text: 真老大？
entries.label: team_0070_select_02

entries.text: 這個率領５名老大的神秘人物，\n真實身分完全不清不楚……[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_10

entries.text: 打倒那傢伙，讓那傢伙宣布天星隊解散，\n那他們就徹底地結束了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_11

entries.text: 討厭受到注目的真老大沒有基地，\n並且一直隱藏著真正的身分。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_12

entries.text: 但是，當老大所有人都引退之後，\n相信真老大就會親自出馬。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_13

entries.text: 關於約定好的報酬，\n我把ＬＰ儲值到[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的手機吧。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_15

entries.text: 可以用招式學習器機製作的\n招式學習器種類變多了！
entries.label: team_0070_system_03

entries.text: 讓寶可夢學會強大的招式，\n在今後的對戰中派上用場吧。\r\n……補給班應該就快來了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0070_cassiopeia_14

entries.text: 呃、呃……\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳在談什麼很重大的話題嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0070_botan_02

entries.text: 啊嘎嘶！！
entries.label: team_0070_legend_01

entries.text: 嗚哇哇哇！\n人家可沒有在問你啊！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0070_botan_03

entries.text: 幕後黑手的存在……\n人家也從仙后那裡聽說了。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0070_botan_05

entries.text: 天星隊的創始者，\n萬惡的根源……[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0070_botan_06

entries.text: 不打倒那傢伙的話，\n人家會失去自己的寶物……[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0070_botan_07

entries.text: 什麼意思？
entries.label: team_0070_select_03

entries.text: 牡丹的寶物？
entries.label: team_0070_select_04

entries.text: 呃……報酬！\n趁人家還沒忘記的時候……拿去吧！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0070_botan_09

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]獲得了\n很多寶可夢的[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]掉落物[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: team_0070_system_04
